item.title: Acquittal came after nearly 4 years in hiding

item.title: First person: The Shepherd’s guiding staff
item.description: A shepherd’s staff is used to rescue a lost or entangled sheep, but it is also the tool by which a shepherd affectionately guides his flock.

item.title: 10 things we can learn from believers around the world
item.description: In my various roles, I’ve been privileged to travel the world, talk to global brothers and sisters in Christ, and learn from them. I may be the professor, but they always teach me. Here are some things we can learn.
